items.prompt: Which greedy key has this proof?

options.why: Finishing no later than an optimal first interval lets the greedy choice replace it without blocking the remaining intervals.
An early start can belong to a long interval that blocks several shorter meetings.
A short interval can finish too late to preserve the future choices; duration is not the exchange key.
The objective counts meetings equally; no rewards are present to maximize.

items.explanation: An earlier finish preserves future compatibility.
